verdict.rationale: Docs confirm user notification rules exist: On-Call Readiness Reports audit responders' notification rule configurations, and the REST API configures how users are notified. The mobile app plus hands-on reports show push notifications followed by a phone call if the page isn't acknowledged. SMS and email channels, and per-channel rule configuration, are not explicitly documented in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit SMS channel evidence, explicit email channel evidence, first-party docs describing per-channel notification rule setup (timing and ordering per channel).
